ayahs.ar: حمٓ
ayahs.en: Ha, Meem
ayahs.e2: Ḥâ-Mĩm
ayahs.tr: Haa-Meeem

ayahs.ar: وَٱلۡكِتَٰبِ ٱلۡمُبِينِ
ayahs.en: By the clear Book
ayahs.e2: By the clear Book
ayahs.tr: Wal Kitaabil Mubeen

ayahs.ar: إِنَّا جَعَلۡنَٰهُ قُرۡءَٰنًا عَرَبِيࣰّ ا لَّعَلَّكُمۡ تَعۡقِلُونَ
ayahs.en: Indeed, We have made it an Arabic Qur'an that you might understand
ayahs.e2: Certainly, We have made it a Quran in Arabic so perhaps you will understand
ayahs.tr: Innaa ja'alnaahu Quraanan 'Arabiyyal la'allakum ta'qiloon

ayahs.ar: وَإِنَّهُۥ فِيٓ أُمِّ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ لَدَيۡنَا لَعَلِيٌّ حَكِيمٌ
ayahs.en: And indeed it is, in the Mother of the Book with Us, exalted and full of wisdom
ayahs.e2: And indeed, it is—in the Master Record with Us—highly esteemed, rich in wisdom
ayahs.tr: Wa innahoo feee Ummil Kitaabi Ladainaa la'aliyyun hakeem

ayahs.ar: أَفَنَضۡرِبُ عَنكُمُ ٱلذِّكۡرَ صَفۡحًا أَن كُنتُمۡ قَوۡمࣰ ا مُّسۡرِفِينَ
ayahs.en: Then should We turn the message away, disregarding you, because you are a transgressing people
ayahs.e2: Should We then turn the ˹Quranic˺ Reminder away from you ˹simply˺ because you have been a transgressing people
ayahs.tr: Afanadribu 'ankumuz Zikra safhan an kuntum qawmam musrifeen

ayahs.ar: وَكَمۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مِن نَّبِيࣲّ فِي ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.en: And how many a prophet We sent among the former peoples
ayahs.e2: ˹Imagine˺ how many prophets We sent to those ˹destroyed˺ before
ayahs.tr: Wa kam arsalnaa min Nabiyyin fil awwaleen

ayahs.ar: وَمَا يَأۡتِيهِم مِّن نَّبِيٍّ إِلَّا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُونَ
ayahs.en: But there would not come to them a prophet except that they used to ridicule him
ayahs.e2: But no prophet ever came to them without being mocked
ayahs.tr: Wa maa yaateehim min Nabiyyin illaa kaanoo bihee yasahzi'oon

ayahs.ar: فَأَهۡلَكۡنَآ أَشَدَّ مِنۡهُم بَطۡشࣰ ا وَمَضَىٰ مَثَلُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.en: And We destroyed greater than them in [striking] power, and the example of the former peoples has preceded
ayahs.e2: So We destroyed those who were far mightier than these ˹Meccans˺. The examples of ˹their˺ predecessors have ˹already˺ been related
ayahs.tr: Fa ahlaknaaa ashadda minhum batshanw wa madaa masalul lawwaleen

ayahs.ar: وَلَئِن سَأَلۡتَهُم مَّنۡ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ لَيَقُولُنَّ خَلَقَهُنَّ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ
ayahs.en: And if you should ask them, "Who has created the heavens and the earth?" they would surely say, "They were created by the Exalted in Might, the Knowing
ayahs.e2: If you ask them ˹O Prophet˺ who created the heavens and the earth, they will certainly say, “The Almighty, All-Knowing did.”
ayahs.tr: Wa la'in sa altahum man khalaqas samaawaati wal arda la yaqoolunna khalaqa hunnal 'Azeezul 'Aleem

ayahs.ar: ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ مَهۡدࣰ ا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمۡ فِيهَا سُبُلࣰ ا لَّعَلَّكُمۡ تَهۡتَدُونَ
ayahs.en: [The one] who has made for you the earth a bed and made for you upon it roads that you might be guided
ayahs.e2: ˹He is the One˺ Who has laid out the earth for you, and set in it pathways for you so that you may find your way
ayahs.tr: Allazee ja'ala lakumul arda mahdanw wa ja'ala lakum feehaa subulal la'allakum tahtadoon

ayahs.ar: وَٱلَّذِي نَزَّلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءَۢ بِقَدَرࣲ فَأَنشَرۡنَا بِهِۦ بَلۡدَةࣰ مَّيۡتࣰ اۚ كَذَٰلِكَ تُخۡرَجُونَ
ayahs.en: And who sends down rain from the sky in measured amounts, and We revive thereby a dead land - thus will you be brought forth
ayahs.e2: And ˹He is the One˺ Who sends down rain from the sky in perfect measure, with which We give life to a lifeless land. And so will you be brought forth ˹from the grave˺
ayahs.tr: Wallazee nazzala minas samaaa'i maaa'am biqadarin fa anshamaa bihee baldatam maitaa' kazaalika tukhrajoon

ayahs.ar: وَٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلۡأَزۡوَٰجَ كُلَّهَا وَجَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡفُلۡكِ وَٱلۡأَنۡعَٰمِ مَا تَرۡكَبُونَ
ayahs.en: And who created the species, all of them, and has made for you of ships and animals those which you mount
ayahs.e2: And ˹He is the One˺ Who created all ˹things in˺ pairs, and made for you ships and animals to ride
ayahs.tr: Wallazee khalaqal azwaaja kullahaa wa ja'ala lakum minal fulki wal-an'aami maa tarkaboon

ayahs.ar: لِتَسۡتَوُۥاْ عَلَىٰ ظُهُورِهِۦ ثُمَّ تَذۡكُرُواْ نِعۡمَةَ رَبِّكُمۡ إِذَا ٱسۡتَوَيۡتُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ وَتَقُولُواْ سُبۡحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُۥ مُقۡرِنِينَ
ayahs.en: That you may settle yourselves upon their backs and then remember the favor of your Lord when you have settled upon them and say. "Exalted is He who has subjected this to us, and we could not have [otherwise] subdued it
ayahs.e2: so that you may sit firmly on their backs, and remember your Lord’s blessings once you are settled on them, saying, “Glory be to the One Who has subjected these for us, for we could have never done so ˹on our own˺
ayahs.tr: Litastawoo 'alaa zuhoorihee summa tazkuroo ni'mata Rabbikum izastawaitum 'alaihi wa taqooloo Subhaanal lazee sakhkhara lana haaza wa maa kunnaa lahoo muqrineen

ayahs.ar: وَإِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ
ayahs.en: And indeed we, to our Lord, will [surely] return
ayahs.e2: And surely to our Lord we will ˹all˺ return.”
ayahs.tr: Wa innaaa ilaa Rabbinaa lamunqaliboon

ayahs.ar: وَجَعَلُواْ لَهُۥ مِنۡ عِبَادِهِۦ جُزۡءًاۚ إِنَّ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ لَكَفُورࣱ مُّبِينٌ
ayahs.en: But they have attributed to Him from His servants a portion. Indeed, man is clearly ungrateful
ayahs.e2: Still the pagans have made some of His creation out to be a part of Him. Indeed, humankind is clearly ungrateful
ayahs.tr: Wa ja'aloo lahoo min 'ibaadihee juz'aa; innal insaana lakafoorum mubeen

ayahs.ar: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذَ مِمَّا يَخۡلُقُ بَنَاتࣲ وَأَصۡفَىٰكُم بِٱلۡبَنِينَ
ayahs.en: Or has He taken, out of what He has created, daughters and chosen you for [having] sons
ayahs.e2: Has He taken ˹angels as His˺ daughters from what He created, and favoured you ˹O pagans˺ with sons
ayahs.tr: Amit takhaza mimmaa yakhluqu banaatinw wa asfaakum bilbaneen

ayahs.ar: وَإِذَا بُشِّرَ أَحَدُهُم بِمَا ضَرَبَ لِلرَّحۡمَٰنِ مَثَلࣰ ا ظَلَّ وَجۡهُهُۥ مُسۡوَدࣰّ ا وَهُوَ كَظِيمٌ
ayahs.en: And when one of them is given good tidings of that which he attributes to the Most Merciful in comparison, his face becomes dark, and he suppresses grief
ayahs.e2: Whenever one of them is given the good news of what they attribute to the Most Compassionate, his face grows gloomy, as he suppresses his rage
ayahs.tr: Wa izaa bushshira ahaduhum bimaa daraba lir Rahmaani masalan zalla wajhuhoo muswaddanw wa hua kazeem

ayahs.ar: أَوَمَن يُنَشَّؤُاْ فِي ٱلۡحِلۡيَةِ وَهُوَ فِي ٱلۡخِصَامِ غَيۡرُ مُبِينࣲ‏
ayahs.en: So is one brought up in ornaments while being during conflict unevident [attributed to Allah]
ayahs.e2: ˹Do they attribute to Him˺ those who are brought up in fineries and are not commanding in disputes
ayahs.tr: Awa mai yunashsha'u fil hilyati wa huwa fil khisaami ghairu mubeen

ayahs.ar: وَجَعَلُواْ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ ٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ عِبَٰدُ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ إِنَٰثًاۚ أَشَهِدُواْ خَلۡقَهُمۡۚ سَتُكۡتَبُ شَهَٰدَتُهُمۡ وَيُسۡـَٔلُونَ
ayahs.en: And they have made the angels, who are servants of the Most Merciful, females. Did they witness their creation? Their testimony will be recorded, and they will be questioned
ayahs.e2: Still they have labelled the angels, who are servants of the Most Compassionate, as female. Did they witness their creation? Their statement will be recorded, and they will be questioned
ayahs.tr: Wa ja'alul malaaa'ikatal lazeena hum 'ibaadur Rahmaani inaasaa; a shahidoo khalaqhum; satuktabu shahaa datuhum wa yus'aloon

ayahs.ar: وَقَالُواْ لَوۡ شَآءَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ مَا عَبَدۡنَٰهُمۗ مَّا لَهُم بِذَٰلِكَ مِنۡ عِلۡمٍۖ إِنۡ هُمۡ إِلَّا يَخۡرُصُونَ
ayahs.en: And they said, "If the Most Merciful had willed, we would not have worshipped them." They have of that no knowledge. They are not but falsifying
ayahs.e2: And they argue, “Had the Most Compassionate willed, we would have never worshipped them.” They have no knowledge ˹in support˺ of this ˹claim˺. They do nothing but lie
ayahs.tr: Wa qaaloo law shaaa'ar Rahmaanu maa 'abadnaahum; maa lahum bizaalika min 'ilmin in hum illaa yakhrusoon

ayahs.ar: أَمۡ ءَاتَيۡنَٰهُمۡ كِتَٰبࣰ ا مِّن قَبۡلِهِۦ فَهُم بِهِۦ مُسۡتَمۡسِكُونَ
ayahs.en: Or have We given them a book before the Qur'an to which they are adhering
ayahs.e2: Or have We given them a Book ˹for proof˺, before this ˹Quran˺, to which they are holding firm
ayahs.tr: Am aatainaahum Kitaabam min qablihee fahum bihee mustamsikoon

ayahs.ar: بَلۡ قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا وَجَدۡنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا عَلَىٰٓ أُمَّةࣲ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَٰرِهِم مُّهۡتَدُونَ
ayahs.en: Rather, they say, "Indeed, we found our fathers upon a religion, and we are in their footsteps [rightly] guided
ayahs.e2: In fact, they say, “We found our forefathers following a ˹particular˺ way, and we are following in their footsteps.”
ayahs.tr: Bal qaalooo innaa wajadnaaa aabaaa'anaa 'alaaa ummatinw wa innaa 'alaaa aasaarihim muhtadoon

ayahs.ar: وَكَذَٰلِكَ مَآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مِن قَبۡلِكَ فِي قَرۡيَةࣲ مِّن نَّذِيرٍ إِلَّا قَالَ مُتۡرَفُوهَآ إِنَّا وَجَدۡنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا عَلَىٰٓ أُمَّةࣲ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَٰرِهِم مُّقۡتَدُونَ
ayahs.en: And similarly, We did not send before you any warner into a city except that its affluent said, "Indeed, we found our fathers upon a religion, and we are, in their footsteps, following
ayahs.e2: Similarly, whenever We sent a warner to a society before you ˹O Prophet˺, its ˹spoiled˺ elite would say, “We found our forefathers following a ˹particular˺ way, and we are walking in their footsteps.”
ayahs.tr: Wa kazaalika maaa arsalnaa min qablika fee qaryatim min nazeerin illaa qaala mutrafoohaaa innaa wajadnaaa aabaaa'anaa 'alaaa ummatinw wa innaa 'alaaa aasaarihim muqtadoon

ayahs.ar: ۞قَٰلَ أَوَلَوۡ جِئۡتُكُم بِأَهۡدَىٰ مِمَّا وَجَدتُّمۡ عَلَيۡهِ ءَابَآءَكُمۡۖ قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا بِمَآ أُرۡسِلۡتُم بِهِۦ كَٰفِرُونَ
ayahs.en: [Each warner] said, "Even if I brought you better guidance than that [religion] upon which you found your fathers?" They said, "Indeed we, in that with which you were sent, are disbelievers
ayahs.e2: Each ˹warner˺ asked, “Even if what I brought you is better guidance than what you found your forefathers practicing?” They replied, “We totally reject whatever you have been sent with.”
ayahs.tr: Qaala awa law ji'tukum bi ahdaa mimmaa wajattum 'alaihi aabaaa'akum qaalooo innaa bimaaa ursiltum bihee kaafiroon

ayahs.ar: فَٱنتَقَمۡنَا مِنۡهُمۡۖ فَٱنظُرۡ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ
ayahs.en: So we took retribution from them; then see how was the end of the deniers
ayahs.e2: So We inflicted punishment upon them. See then what was the fate of the deniers
ayahs.tr: Fantaqamnaa minhum fanzur kaifa kaana 'aaqibatul mukazzibeen

ayahs.ar: وَإِذۡ قَالَ إِبۡرَٰهِيمُ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوۡمِهِۦٓ إِنَّنِي بَرَآءࣱ مِّمَّا تَعۡبُدُونَ
ayahs.en: And [mention, O Muhammad], when Abraham said to his father and his people, "Indeed, I am disassociated from that which you worship
ayahs.e2: ˹Remember, O Prophet˺ when Abraham declared to his father and his people, “I am totally free of whatever ˹gods˺ you worship
ayahs.tr: Wa iz qaala Ibraaheemu liabeehi wa qawmiheee innane baraaa'um mimmaa ta'budo

ayahs.ar: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِي فَطَرَنِي فَإِنَّهُۥ سَيَهۡدِينِ
ayahs.en: Except for He who created me; and indeed, He will guide me
ayahs.e2: except the One Who originated me, and He will surely guide me.”
ayahs.tr: Illal lazee fataranee innahoo sa yahdeen

ayahs.ar: وَجَعَلَهَا كَلِمَةَۢ بَاقِيَةࣰ فِي عَقِبِهِۦ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَرۡجِعُونَ
ayahs.en: And he made it a word remaining among his descendants that they might return [to it]
ayahs.e2: And he left this enduring declaration among his descendants, so they may ˹always˺ turn back ˹to Allah˺
ayahs.tr: Wa ja'alahaa Kalimatam baaqiyatan fee 'aqibihee la'al lahum yarji'oon

ayahs.ar: بَلۡ مَتَّعۡتُ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ وَءَابَآءَهُمۡ حَتَّىٰ جَآءَهُمُ ٱلۡحَقُّ وَرَسُولࣱ مُّبِينࣱ‏
ayahs.en: However, I gave enjoyment to these [people of Makkah] and their fathers until there came to them the truth and a clear Messenger
ayahs.e2: In fact, I had allowed enjoyment for these ˹Meccans˺ and their forefathers, until the truth came to them along with a messenger making things clear
ayahs.tr: Bal matta'tu haaa'ulaaa'i wa aabaaa'ahum hattaa jaaa'a humul haqqu wa Rasoolum mubeen

ayahs.ar: وَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلۡحَقُّ قَالُواْ هَٰذَا سِحۡرࣱ وَإِنَّا بِهِۦ كَٰفِرُونَ
ayahs.en: But when the truth came to them, they said, "This is magic, and indeed we are, concerning it, disbelievers
ayahs.e2: ˹But˺ when the truth came to them, they said, “This is magic, and we totally reject it.”
ayahs.tr: Wa lammaa jaaa'ahumul haqqu qaaloo haazaa sihrunw wa innaa bihee kaafiroon

ayahs.ar: وَقَالُواْ لَوۡلَا نُزِّلَ هَٰذَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانُ عَلَىٰ رَجُلࣲ مِّنَ ٱلۡقَرۡيَتَيۡنِ عَظِيمٍ
ayahs.en: And they said, "Why was this Qur'an not sent down upon a great man from [one of] the two cities
ayahs.e2: And they exclaimed, “If only this Quran was revealed to a great man from ˹one of˺ the two cities!”
ayahs.tr: Wa qaaloo law laa nuzzila haazal Quraanu 'alaa rajulim minal qaryataini 'azeem

ayahs.ar: أَهُمۡ يَقۡسِمُونَ رَحۡمَتَ رَبِّكَۚ نَحۡنُ قَسَمۡنَا بَيۡنَهُم مَّعِيشَتَهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَاۚ وَرَفَعۡنَا بَعۡضَهُمۡ فَوۡقَ بَعۡضࣲ دَرَجَٰتࣲ لِّيَتَّخِذَ بَعۡضُهُم بَعۡضࣰ ا سُخۡرِيࣰّ اۗ وَرَحۡمَتُ رَبِّكَ خَيۡرࣱ مِّمَّا يَجۡمَعُونَ
ayahs.en: Do they distribute the mercy of your Lord? It is We who have apportioned among them their livelihood in the life of this world and have raised some of them above others in degrees [of rank] that they may make use of one another for service. But the mercy of your Lord is better than whatever they accumulate
ayahs.e2: Is it they who distribute your Lord’s mercy? We ˹alone˺ have distributed their ˹very˺ livelihood among them in this worldly life and raised some of them in rank above others so that some may employ others in service. ˹But˺ your Lord’s mercy is far better than whatever ˹wealth˺ they amass
ayahs.tr: Ahum yaqsimoona rahmata Rabbik; Nahnu qasamnaa bainahum ma'eeshatahum fil hayaatid dunyaa wa rafa'naa ba'dahum fawqa ba'din darajaatil liyattakhiza ba'duhum ba'dan sukhriyyaa; wa rahmatu Rabbika khairum mimmaa yajma'oon

ayahs.ar: وَلَوۡلَآ أَن يَكُونَ ٱلنَّاسُ أُمَّةࣰ وَٰحِدَةࣰ لَّجَعَلۡنَا لِمَن يَكۡفُرُ بِٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ لِبُيُوتِهِمۡ سُقُفࣰ ا مِّن فِضَّةࣲ وَمَعَارِجَ عَلَيۡهَا يَظۡهَرُونَ
ayahs.en: And if it were not that the people would become one community [of disbelievers], We would have made for those who disbelieve in the Most Merciful - for their houses - ceilings and stairways of silver upon which to mount
ayahs.e2: Were it not that people might ˹be tempted to˺ become one community ˹of disbelievers˺, We would have supplied the homes of ˹only˺ those who disbelieve in the Most Compassionate with silver roofs and ˹silver˺ stairways to ascend
ayahs.tr: Wa law laaa any yakoonan naasu ummatanw waahidatal laja'alnaa limany yakfuru bir Rahmaani libu yootihim suqufam min fiddatinw wa ma'aarija 'alaihaa yazharoon

ayahs.ar: وَلِبُيُوتِهِمۡ أَبۡوَٰبࣰ ا وَسُرُرًا عَلَيۡهَا يَتَّكِـُٔونَ
ayahs.en: And for their houses - doors and couches [of silver] upon which to recline
ayahs.e2: as well as ˹silver˺ gates and thrones to recline on
ayahs.tr: Wa libu yootihim abwaabanw wa sururan 'alaihaa yattaki'oon

ayahs.ar: وَزُخۡرُفࣰ اۚ وَإِن كُلُّ ذَٰلِكَ لَمَّا مَتَٰعُ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَاۚ وَٱلۡأٓخِرَةُ عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلۡمُتَّقِينَ
ayahs.en: And gold ornament. But all that is not but the enjoyment of worldly life. And the Hereafter with your Lord is for the righteous
ayahs.e2: and ornaments ˹of gold˺. Yet all this is no more than a ˹fleeting˺ enjoyment in this worldly life. ˹But˺ the Hereafter with your Lord is ˹only˺ for those mindful ˹of Him˺
ayahs.tr: Wa zukhrufaa; wa in kullu zaalika lammaa mataa'ul hayaatid dunyaa; wal aakhiratu 'inda Rabbika lilmuttaqeen

ayahs.ar: وَمَن يَعۡشُ عَن ذِكۡرِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ نُقَيِّضۡ لَهُۥ شَيۡطَٰنࣰ ا فَهُوَ لَهُۥ قَرِينࣱ‏
ayahs.en: And whoever is blinded from remembrance of the Most Merciful - We appoint for him a devil, and he is to him a companion
ayahs.e2: And whoever turns a blind eye to the Reminder of the Most Compassionate, We place at the disposal of each a devilish one as their close associate
ayahs.tr: Wa mai ya'shu 'an zikrir Rahmaani nuqaiyid lahoo Shaitaanan fahuwa lahoo qareen

ayahs.ar: وَإِنَّهُمۡ لَيَصُدُّونَهُمۡ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَيَحۡسَبُونَ أَنَّهُم مُّهۡتَدُونَ
ayahs.en: And indeed, the devils avert them from the way [of guidance] while they think that they are [rightly] guided
ayahs.e2: who will certainly hinder them from the ˹Right˺ Way while they think they are ˹rightly˺ guided
ayahs.tr: Wa innahum la yasuddoo nahum 'anis sabeeli wa yahsaboona annahum muhtadoon

ayahs.ar: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَنَا قَالَ يَٰلَيۡتَ بَيۡنِي وَبَيۡنَكَ بُعۡدَ ٱلۡمَشۡرِقَيۡنِ فَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡقَرِينُ
ayahs.en: Until, when he comes to Us [at Judgement], he says [to his companion], "Oh, I wish there was between me and you the distance between the east and west - how wretched a companion
ayahs.e2: But when such a person comes to Us, one will say ˹to their associate˺, “I wish you were as distant from me as the east is from the west! What an evil associate ˹you were˺!”
ayahs.tr: Hattaaa izaa jaaa'anaa qaala yaa laita bainee wa bainaka bu'dal mashriqaini fabi'sal qareen

ayahs.ar: وَلَن يَنفَعَكُمُ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ إِذ ظَّلَمۡتُمۡ أَنَّكُمۡ فِي ٱلۡعَذَابِ مُشۡتَرِكُونَ
ayahs.en: And never will it benefit you that Day, when you have wronged, that you are [all] sharing in the punishment
ayahs.e2: ˹It will be said to both,˺ “Since you all did wrong, sharing in the punishment will be of no benefit to you this Day.”
ayahs.tr: Wa lai yanfa'akumul Yawma iz zalamtum annakum fil 'azaabi mushtarikoon

ayahs.ar: أَفَأَنتَ تُسۡمِعُ ٱلصُّمَّ أَوۡ تَهۡدِي ٱلۡعُمۡيَ وَمَن كَانَ فِي ضَلَٰلࣲ مُّبِينࣲ‏
ayahs.en: Then will you make the deaf hear, [O Muhammad], or guide the blind or he who is in clear error
ayahs.e2: Can you make the deaf hear, or guide the blind or those clearly astray
ayahs.tr: Afa anta tusmi'us summa aw tahdil 'umya wa man kaana fee dalaalim mubeen

ayahs.ar: فَإِمَّا نَذۡهَبَنَّ بِكَ فَإِنَّا مِنۡهُم مُّنتَقِمُونَ
ayahs.en: And whether [or not] We take you away [in death], indeed, We will take retribution upon them
ayahs.e2: Even if We take you away ˹from this world˺, We will surely inflict punishment upon them
ayahs.tr: Fa immaa nazhabanna bika fa innaa minhum muntaqimoon

ayahs.ar: أَوۡ نُرِيَنَّكَ ٱلَّذِي وَعَدۡنَٰهُمۡ فَإِنَّا عَلَيۡهِم مُّقۡتَدِرُونَ
ayahs.en: Or whether [or not] We show you that which We have promised them, indeed, We are Perfect in Ability
ayahs.e2: Or if We show you what We threaten them with, We certainly have full power over them
ayahs.tr: Aw nuriyannakal lazee wa'adnaahum fa innaa 'alaihim muqtadiroon

ayahs.ar: فَٱسۡتَمۡسِكۡ بِٱلَّذِيٓ أُوحِيَ إِلَيۡكَۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطࣲ مُّسۡتَقِيمࣲ‏
ayahs.en: So adhere to that which is revealed to you. Indeed, you are on a straight path
ayahs.e2: So hold firmly to what has been revealed to you ˹O Prophet˺. You are truly on the Straight Path
ayahs.tr: Fastamsik billazeee oohi ya ilaika innaka 'alaa Siraatim Mustaqeem

ayahs.ar: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَذِكۡرࣱ لَّكَ وَلِقَوۡمِكَۖ وَسَوۡفَ تُسۡـَٔلُونَ
ayahs.en: And indeed, it is a remembrance for you and your people, and you [all] are going to be questioned
ayahs.e2: Surely this ˹Quran˺ is a glory for you and your people. And you will ˹all˺ be questioned ˹about it˺
ayahs.tr: Wa innahoo lazikrul laka wa liqawmika wa sawfa tus'aloon

ayahs.ar: وَسۡـَٔلۡ مَنۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مِن قَبۡلِكَ مِن رُّسُلِنَآ أَجَعَلۡنَا مِن دُونِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ ءَالِهَةࣰ يُعۡبَدُونَ
ayahs.en: And ask those We sent before you of Our messengers; have We made besides the Most Merciful deities to be worshipped
ayahs.e2: Ask ˹the followers of˺ the messengers that We already sent before you if We ˹ever˺ appointed ˹other˺ gods to be worshipped besides the Most Compassionate
ayahs.tr: Was'al man arsalnaa min qablika mir Rusulinaaa aja'alnaa min doonir Rahmaani aalihatany yu badoon

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مُوسَىٰ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَمَلَإِيْهِۦ فَقَالَ إِنِّي رَسُولُ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.en: And certainly did We send Moses with Our signs to Pharaoh and his establishment, and he said, "Indeed, I am the messenger of the Lord of the worlds
ayahs.e2: Indeed, We sent Moses with Our signs to Pharaoh and his chiefs, and he said: “I am a messenger of the Lord of all worlds.”
ayahs.tr: Wa laqad arsalnaa Moosaa bi aayaatinaaa ilaa Fir'awna wa mala'ihee faqaala innee Rasoolu Rabbil 'aalameen

ayahs.ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُم بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ إِذَا هُم مِّنۡهَا يَضۡحَكُونَ
ayahs.en: But when he brought them Our signs, at once they laughed at them
ayahs.e2: But as soon as he came to them with Our signs, they laughed at them
ayahs.tr: Falammma jaaa'ahum bi aayaatinaaa izaa hum minhaa yadhakoon

ayahs.ar: وَمَا نُرِيهِم مِّنۡ ءَايَةٍ إِلَّا هِيَ أَكۡبَرُ مِنۡ أُخۡتِهَاۖ وَأَخَذۡنَٰهُم بِٱلۡعَذَابِ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَرۡجِعُونَ
ayahs.en: And We showed them not a sign except that it was greater than its sister, and We seized them with affliction that perhaps they might return [to faith]
ayahs.e2: although every sign We showed them was greater than the one before. Ultimately, We seized them with torments so that they might return ˹to the Right Path˺
ayahs.tr: Wa maa nureehim min aayatin illaa hiya akbaru min ukhtihaa wa akhaznaahum bil'azaabi la'allahum yarji'oon

ayahs.ar: وَقَالُواْ يَٰٓأَيُّهَ ٱلسَّاحِرُ ٱدۡعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ بِمَا عَهِدَ عِندَكَ إِنَّنَا لَمُهۡتَدُونَ
ayahs.en: And they said [to Moses], "O magician, invoke for us your Lord by what He has promised you. Indeed, we will be guided
ayahs.e2: ˹Then˺ they pleaded, “O ˹mighty˺ magician! Pray to your Lord on our behalf, by virtue of the covenant He made with you. We will certainly accept guidance.”
ayahs.tr: Wa qaaloo yaaa ayyuhas saahirud'u lanaa Rabbaka bimaa 'ahida 'indaka innanaa lamuhtadoon

ayahs.ar: فَلَمَّا كَشَفۡنَا عَنۡهُمُ ٱلۡعَذَابَ إِذَا هُمۡ يَنكُثُونَ
ayahs.en: But when We removed from them the affliction, at once they broke their word
ayahs.e2: But as soon as We removed the torments from them, they broke their promise
ayahs.tr: Falammaa kashafnaa 'anhumul 'azaaba izaa hum yankusoon

ayahs.ar: وَنَادَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنُ فِي قَوۡمِهِۦ قَالَ يَٰقَوۡمِ أَلَيۡسَ لِي مُلۡكُ مِصۡرَ وَهَٰذِهِ ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِيٓۚ أَفَلَا تُبۡصِرُونَ
ayahs.en: And Pharaoh called out among his people; he said, "O my people, does not the kingdom of Egypt belong to me, and these rivers flowing beneath me; then do you not see
ayahs.e2: And Pharaoh called out to his people, boasting, “O my people! Am I not sovereign over Egypt as well as ˹all˺ these streams flowing at my feet? Can you not see
ayahs.tr: Wa naadaa Fir'awnu fee qawmihee qaala yaa qawmi alaisa lee mulku Misra wa haazihil anhaaru tajree min tahtee afalaa tubsiroon

ayahs.ar: أَمۡ أَنَا۠ خَيۡرࣱ مِّنۡ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِي هُوَ مَهِينࣱ وَلَا يَكَادُ يُبِينُ
ayahs.en: Or am I [not] better than this one who is insignificant and hardly makes himself clear
ayahs.e2: Am I not better than this nobody who can hardly express himself
ayahs.tr: Am ana khairum min haazal lazee huwa maheenunw wa laa yuakaadu yubeen

ayahs.ar: فَلَوۡلَآ أُلۡقِيَ عَلَيۡهِ أَسۡوِرَةࣱ مِّن ذَهَبٍ أَوۡ جَآءَ مَعَهُ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ مُقۡتَرِنِينَ
ayahs.en: Then why have there not been placed upon him bracelets of gold or come with him the angels in conjunction
ayahs.e2: Why then have no golden bracelets ˹of kingship˺ been granted to him or angels come with him as escorts!”
ayahs.tr: Falaw laa ulqiya 'alaihi aswiratum min zahabin awjaaa'a ma'ahul malaaa'ikatu muqtarineen

ayahs.ar: فَٱسۡتَخَفَّ قَوۡمَهُۥ فَأَطَاعُوهُۚ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ قَوۡمࣰ ا فَٰسِقِينَ
ayahs.en: So he bluffed his people, and they obeyed him. Indeed, they were [themselves] a people defiantly disobedient [of Allah]
ayahs.e2: And so he fooled his people, and they obeyed him. They were truly a rebellious people
ayahs.tr: Fastakhaffa qawmahoo fa ataa'ooh; innahum kaanoo qawman faasiqeen

ayahs.ar: فَلَمَّآ ءَاسَفُونَا ٱنتَقَمۡنَا مِنۡهُمۡ فَأَغۡرَقۡنَٰهُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ
ayahs.en: And when they angered Us, We took retribution from them and drowned them all
ayahs.e2: So when they enraged Us, We inflicted punishment upon them, drowning them all
ayahs.tr: Falammaaa aasafoonan taqamnaa minhum fa aghraqnaahum ajma'een

ayahs.ar: فَجَعَلۡنَٰهُمۡ سَلَفࣰ ا وَمَثَلࣰ ا لِّلۡأٓخِرِينَ
ayahs.en: And We made them a precedent and an example for the later peoples
ayahs.e2: And We made them an example and a lesson for those after them
ayahs.tr: Faja'alnaahum salafanw wa masalal lil aakhireen

ayahs.ar: ۞وَلَمَّا ضُرِبَ ٱبۡنُ مَرۡيَمَ مَثَلًا إِذَا قَوۡمُكَ مِنۡهُ يَصِدُّونَ
ayahs.en: And when the son of Mary was presented as an example, immediately your people laughed aloud
ayahs.e2: When the son of Mary was cited as an example ˹in argument˺, your people ˹O Prophet˺ broke into ˹joyful˺ applause
ayahs.tr: Wa lammaa duribab nu Maryama masalan izaa qawmu ka minhu yasidoon

ayahs.ar: وَقَالُوٓاْ ءَأَٰلِهَتُنَا خَيۡرٌ أَمۡ هُوَۚ مَا ضَرَبُوهُ لَكَ إِلَّا جَدَلَۢاۚ بَلۡ هُمۡ قَوۡمٌ خَصِمُونَ
ayahs.en: And they said, "Are your gods better, or is he?" They did not present the comparison except for [mere] argument. But, [in fact], they are a people prone to dispute
ayahs.e2: They exclaimed, “Which is better: our gods or Jesus?” They cite him only to argue. In fact, they are a people prone to dispute
ayahs.tr: Wa qaalooo 'a-aalihatunaa khairun am hoo; maa daraboohu laka illaa jadalaa; balhum qawmun khasimoon

ayahs.ar: إِنۡ هُوَ إِلَّا عَبۡدٌ أَنۡعَمۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ وَجَعَلۡنَٰهُ مَثَلࣰ ا لِّبَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ
ayahs.en: Jesus was not but a servant upon whom We bestowed favor, and We made him an example for the Children of Israel
ayahs.e2: He was only a servant We showed favour to, and made as an example for the Children of Israel
ayahs.tr: In huwa illaa 'abdun an'amnaa 'alaihi wa ja'alnaahu masalal li Baneee Israaa'eel

ayahs.ar: وَلَوۡ نَشَآءُ لَجَعَلۡنَا مِنكُم مَّلَٰٓئِكَةࣰ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ يَخۡلُفُونَ
ayahs.en: And if We willed, We could have made [instead] of you angels succeeding [one another] on the earth
ayahs.e2: Had We willed, We could have easily replaced you ˹all˺ with angels, succeeding one another on earth
ayahs.tr: Wa law nashaaa'u laja'alnaa minkum malaaa'ikatan fil ardi yakhlufoon

ayahs.ar: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَعِلۡمࣱ لِّلسَّاعَةِ فَلَا تَمۡتَرُنَّ بِهَا وَٱتَّبِعُونِۚ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطࣱ مُّسۡتَقِيمࣱ‏
ayahs.en: And indeed, Jesus will be [a sign for] knowledge of the Hour, so be not in doubt of it, and follow Me. This is a straight path
ayahs.e2: And his ˹second˺ coming is truly a sign for the Hour. So have no doubt about it, and follow me. This is the Straight Path
ayahs.tr: Wa innahoo la'ilmul lis Saa'ati fala tamtarunna bihaa wattabi'oon; haazaa Siraatum Mustaqeem

ayahs.ar: وَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكُمُ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمۡ عَدُوࣱّ مُّبِينࣱ‏
ayahs.en: And never let Satan avert you. Indeed, he is to you a clear enemy
ayahs.e2: And do not let Satan hinder you, ˹for˺ he is certainly your sworn enemy
ayahs.tr: Wa laa yasuddan nakumush Shaitaanu innahoo lakum 'aduwwum mubeen

ayahs.ar: وَلَمَّا جَآءَ عِيسَىٰ بِٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتِ قَالَ قَدۡ جِئۡتُكُم بِٱلۡحِكۡمَةِ وَلِأُبَيِّنَ لَكُم بَعۡضَ ٱلَّذِي تَخۡتَلِفُونَ فِيهِۖ فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
ayahs.en: And when Jesus brought clear proofs, he said, "I have come to you with wisdom and to make clear to you some of that over which you differ, so fear Allah and obey me
ayahs.e2: When Jesus came with clear proofs, he declared, “I have come to you with wisdom, and to clarify to you some of what you differ about. So fear Allah, and obey me
ayahs.tr: Wa lammaa jaaa'a 'Eesaa bilbaiyinaati qaala qad ji'tukum bil Hikmati wa li-ubaiyina lakum ba'dal lazee takhtalifoona feehi fattaqul laaha wa atee'oon

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ رَبِّي وَرَبُّكُمۡ فَٱعۡبُدُوهُۚ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطࣱ مُّسۡتَقِيمࣱ‏
ayahs.en: Indeed, Allah is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. This is a straight path
ayahs.e2: Surely Allah ˹alone˺ is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him ˹alone˺. This is the Straight Path.”
ayahs.tr: Innal laaha Huwa Rabbee wa Rabbukum fa'budooh; haaza Siraatum Mustaqeem

ayahs.ar: فَٱخۡتَلَفَ ٱلۡأَحۡزَابُ مِنۢ بَيۡنِهِمۡۖ فَوَيۡلࣱ لِّلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ مِنۡ عَذَابِ يَوۡمٍ أَلِيمٍ
ayahs.en: But the denominations from among them differed [and separated], so woe to those who have wronged from the punishment of a painful Day
ayahs.e2: Yet their ˹various˺ groups have differed among themselves ˹about him˺, so woe to the wrongdoers when they face the torment of a painful Day
ayahs.tr: Fakhtalafal ahzaabu mim bainihim fawailul lillazeena zalamoo min 'azaabi Yawmin aleem

ayahs.ar: هَلۡ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا ٱلسَّاعَةَ أَن تَأۡتِيَهُم بَغۡتَةࣰ وَهُمۡ لَا يَشۡعُرُونَ
ayahs.en: Are they waiting except for the Hour to come upon them suddenly while they perceive not
ayahs.e2: Are they waiting for the Hour to take them by surprise when they least expect ˹it˺
ayahs.tr: Hal yanzuroona illas Saa'ata an taatiyahum baghtatanw wa hum laa yash'uroon

ayahs.ar: ٱلۡأَخِلَّآءُ يَوۡمَئِذِۭ بَعۡضُهُمۡ لِبَعۡضٍ عَدُوٌّ إِلَّا ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ
ayahs.en: Close friends, that Day, will be enemies to each other, except for the righteous
ayahs.e2: Close friends will be enemies to one another on that Day, except the righteous
ayahs.tr: Al akhillaaa'u Yawma'izim ba'duhum liba'din 'aduwwun illal muttaqeen

ayahs.ar: يَٰعِبَادِ لَا خَوۡفٌ عَلَيۡكُمُ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ وَلَآ أَنتُمۡ تَحۡزَنُونَ
ayahs.en: [To whom Allah will say], "O My servants, no fear will there be concerning you this Day, nor will you grieve
ayahs.e2: ˹who will be told,˺ “O My servants! There is no fear for you Today, nor will you grieve—
ayahs.tr: Yaa 'ibaadi laa khawfun 'alaikumul Yawma wa laaa antum tahzanoon

ayahs.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَكَانُواْ مُسۡلِمِينَ
ayahs.en: [You] who believed in Our verses and were Muslims
ayahs.e2: ˹those˺ who believed in Our signs and ˹fully˺ submitted ˹to Us˺
ayahs.tr: Allazeena aamanoo bi Aayaatinaa wa kaanoo muslimeen

ayahs.ar: ٱدۡخُلُواْ ٱلۡجَنَّةَ أَنتُمۡ وَأَزۡوَٰجُكُمۡ تُحۡبَرُونَ
ayahs.en: Enter Paradise, you and your kinds, delighted
ayahs.e2: Enter Paradise, you and your spouses, rejoicing.”
ayahs.tr: Udkhulul Jannata antum wa azwaajukum tuhbaroon

ayahs.ar: يُطَافُ عَلَيۡهِم بِصِحَافࣲ مِّن ذَهَبࣲ وَأَكۡوَابࣲۖ وَفِيهَا مَا تَشۡتَهِيهِ ٱلۡأَنفُسُ وَتَلَذُّ ٱلۡأَعۡيُنُۖ وَأَنتُمۡ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ
ayahs.en: Circulated among them will be plates and vessels of gold. And therein is whatever the souls desire and [what] delights the eyes, and you will abide therein eternally
ayahs.e2: Golden trays and cups will be passed around to them. There will be whatever the souls desire and the eyes delight in. And you will be there forever
ayahs.tr: Yutaafu 'alaihim bishaa fim min zahabinw wa akwaab, wa feehaa maatashtaheehil anfusu wa talazzul a'yunu wa antum feehaa khaalidoon

ayahs.ar: وَتِلۡكَ ٱلۡجَنَّةُ ٱلَّتِيٓ أُورِثۡتُمُوهَا بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
ayahs.en: And that is Paradise which you are made to inherit for what you used to do
ayahs.e2: That is the Paradise which you will be awarded for what you used to do
ayahs.tr: Wa tilkal jannatul lateee ooristumoohaa bimaa kuntum ta'maloon

ayahs.ar: لَكُمۡ فِيهَا فَٰكِهَةࣱ كَثِيرَةࣱ مِّنۡهَا تَأۡكُلُونَ
ayahs.en: For you therein is much fruit from which you will eat
ayahs.e2: There you will have abundant fruit to eat from
ayahs.tr: Lakum feehaa faakihatun kaseeratum minhaa taakuloon

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ فِي عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدُونَ
ayahs.en: Indeed, the criminals will be in the punishment of Hell, abiding eternally
ayahs.e2: Indeed, the wicked will be in the torment of Hell forever
ayahs.tr: Innal mujrimeena fee 'azaabi jahannama khaalidoon

ayahs.ar: لَا يُفَتَّرُ عَنۡهُمۡ وَهُمۡ فِيهِ مُبۡلِسُونَ
ayahs.en: It will not be allowed to subside for them, and they, therein, are in despair
ayahs.e2: It will never be lightened for them, and there they will be overwhelmed with despair
ayahs.tr: Laa yufattaru 'anhum wa hum feehi mublisoon

ayahs.ar: وَمَا ظَلَمۡنَٰهُمۡ وَلَٰكِن كَانُواْ هُمُ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
ayahs.en: And We did not wrong them, but it was they who were the wrongdoers
ayahs.e2: We did not wrong them, but it was they who were the wrongdoers
ayahs.tr: Wa maa zalamnaahum wa laakin kaanoo humuz zaalimeen

ayahs.ar: وَنَادَوۡاْ يَٰمَٰلِكُ لِيَقۡضِ عَلَيۡنَا رَبُّكَۖ قَالَ إِنَّكُم مَّٰكِثُونَ
ayahs.en: And they will call, "O Malik, let your Lord put an end to us!" He will say, "Indeed, you will remain
ayahs.e2: They will cry, “O Mâlik! Let your Lord finish us off.” He will answer, “You are definitely here to stay.”
ayahs.tr: Wa naadaw yaa Maaliku liyaqdi 'alainaa Rabbuka qaala innakum maakisson

ayahs.ar: لَقَدۡ جِئۡنَٰكُم بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَكُمۡ لِلۡحَقِّ كَٰرِهُونَ
ayahs.en: We had certainly brought you the truth, but most of you, to the truth, were averse
ayahs.e2: We certainly brought the truth to you, but most of you were resentful of the truth
ayahs.tr: Laqad ji'naakum bilhaqqi wa laakinna aksarakum lilhaqqi kaarihoon

ayahs.ar: أَمۡ أَبۡرَمُوٓاْ أَمۡرࣰ ا فَإِنَّا مُبۡرِمُونَ
ayahs.en: Or have they devised [some] affair? But indeed, We are devising [a plan]
ayahs.e2: Or have they mastered some ˹evil˺ plan? Then We ˹too˺ are surely planning
ayahs.tr: Am abramooo amran fainnaa mubrimoon

ayahs.ar: أَمۡ يَحۡسَبُونَ أَنَّا لَا نَسۡمَعُ سِرَّهُمۡ وَنَجۡوَىٰهُمۚ بَلَىٰ وَرُسُلُنَا لَدَيۡهِمۡ يَكۡتُبُونَ
ayahs.en: Or do they think that We hear not their secrets and their private conversations? Yes, [We do], and Our messengers are with them recording
ayahs.e2: Or do they think that We do not hear their ˹evil˺ thoughts and secret talks? Yes ˹We do˺! And Our messenger-angels are in their presence, recording ˹it all˺
ayahs.tr: Am yahsaboona annaa laa nasma'u sirrahum wa najwaahum; balaa wa Rusulunaa ladaihim yaktuboon

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ إِن كَانَ لِلرَّحۡمَٰنِ وَلَدࣱ فَأَنَا۠ أَوَّلُ ٱلۡعَٰبِدِينَ
ayahs.en: Say, [O Muhammad], "If the Most Merciful had a son, then I would be the first of [his] worshippers
ayahs.e2: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “If the Most Compassionate ˹really˺ had offspring, I would be the first worshipper.”
ayahs.tr: Qul in kaana lir Rahmaani walad; fa-ana awwalul 'aabideen

ayahs.ar: سُبۡحَٰنَ رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَرۡشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
ayahs.en: Exalted is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, Lord of the Throne, above what they describe
ayahs.e2: Glorified is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord of the Throne, far above what they claim
ayahs.tr: Subhaana Rabbis samaawaati wal ardi Rabbil Arshi 'ammaa yasifoon

ayahs.ar: فَذَرۡهُمۡ يَخُوضُواْ وَيَلۡعَبُواْ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُواْ يَوۡمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِي يُوعَدُونَ
ayahs.en: So leave them to converse vainly and amuse themselves until they meet their Day which they are promised
ayahs.e2: So let them indulge ˹in falsehood˺ and amuse ˹themselves˺ until they face their Day, which they have been warned of
ayahs.tr: Fazarhum yakhoodoo wa yal'aboo hattaa yulaaqoo Yawmahumul lazee yoo'adoon

ayahs.ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِلَٰهࣱ وَفِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ إِلَٰهࣱۚ وَهُوَ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ
ayahs.en: And it is Allah who is [the only] deity in the heaven, and on the earth [the only] deity. And He is the Wise, the Knowing
ayahs.e2: It is He Who is ˹the only˺ God in the heavens and ˹the only˺ God on the earth. For He is the All-Wise, All-Knowing
ayahs.tr: Wa Huwal lazee fissamaaa'i Ilaahunw wa fil ardi Ilaah; wa Huwal Hakeemul'Aleem

ayahs.ar: وَتَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِي لَهُۥ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا وَعِندَهُۥ عِلۡمُ ٱلسَّاعَةِ وَإِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُونَ
ayahs.en: And blessed is He to whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them and with whom is knowledge of the Hour and to whom you will be returned
ayahs.e2: And Blessed is the One to Whom belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and everything in between! With Him ˹alone˺ is the knowledge of the Hour. And to Him you will ˹all˺ be returned
ayahs.tr: Wa tabaarakal lazee lahoo mulkus samaawaati wal ardi wa maa bainahumaa wa 'indahoo 'ilmus Saa'ati wa ilaihi turja'oon

ayahs.ar: وَلَا يَمۡلِكُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَدۡعُونَ مِن دُونِهِ ٱلشَّفَٰعَةَ إِلَّا مَن شَهِدَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَهُمۡ يَعۡلَمُونَ
ayahs.en: And those they invoke besides Him do not possess [power of] intercession; but only those who testify to the truth [can benefit], and they know
ayahs.e2: ˹But˺ those ˹objects of worship˺ they invoke besides Him have no power to intercede, except those who testify to the truth knowingly
ayahs.tr: Wa laa yamlikul lazeena yad'oona min doonihish shafaa'ata illaa man shahida bilhaqqi wa hum ya'lamoon

ayahs.ar: وَلَئِن سَأَلۡتَهُم مَّنۡ خَلَقَهُمۡ لَيَقُولُنَّ ٱللَّهُۖ فَأَنَّىٰ يُؤۡفَكُونَ
ayahs.en: And if you asked them who created them, they would surely say, "Allah." So how are they deluded
ayahs.e2: If you ask them ˹O Prophet˺ who created them, they will certainly say, “Allah!” How can they then be deluded ˹from the truth˺
ayahs.tr: Wa la'in sa altahum man khalaqahum la yaqoolun nallaahu fa annaa yu'fakoon

ayahs.ar: وَقِيلِهِۦ يَٰرَبِّ إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوۡمࣱ لَّا يُؤۡمِنُونَ
ayahs.en: And [Allah acknowledges] his saying, "O my Lord, indeed these are a people who do not believe
ayahs.e2: ˹Allah is Aware of˺ the Prophet’s cry: “O my Lord! Indeed, these are a people who persist in disbelief.”
ayahs.tr: Wa qeelihee yaa Rabbi inna haa'ulaaa'i qawmul laa yu'minoon

ayahs.ar: فَٱصۡفَحۡ عَنۡهُمۡ وَقُلۡ سَلَٰمࣱۚ فَسَوۡفَ يَعۡلَمُونَ
ayahs.en: So turn aside from them and say, "Peace." But they are going to know
ayahs.e2: So bear with them and respond with peace. They will soon come to know
ayahs.tr: Fasfah 'anhum wa qul salaam; fasawfa ya'lamoon
